summary.name: Journey
summary.one_liner: Journey is a multi-platform journal and diary app for writing entries with photos, videos, audio, mood tracking, and location tagging.
use_cases: turning memories into printed or ebook keepsakes
summary.what_it_does:
Journey is a journal and diary app that supports photos, videos, audio, and GIFs in entries. It tags locations using Google Places and Apple Maps and shows media on a map-style Atlas view. A calendar lets users plan and review entries, and a mood-tracking feature shows how mood shifts across 30 days. Entries can be composed via a unique Journey email address or a WhatsApp chat, and exported to DOCX, PDF, and ePUB formats. The page also mentions an open-source Journey Cloud Sync with a Docker image for self-hosting, with full source code described as coming soon.</what_it_does>
